summary: Evolution Metals & Technologies Corp. filed an 8-K on September 17, 2026 disclosing a Securities Purchase Agreement with YA II PN, LTD. (Yorkville) for convertible debentures totaling $30,927,835. The first $22,000,000 debenture was issued immediately, with $2,000,000 and $6,927,835 tranches tied to registration statement filing and effectiveness. Purchase price is 97% of principal; conversion price is the lower of $5.02 or 95% of the 5-day VWAP, subject to a floor and a 4.99% beneficial ownership cap. This is a private placement financing, not a special situation.
